fullDescription: A high-end dark-themed design system featuring glassmorphism, 3D perspective transforms, and an industrial-tech aesthetic. It utilizes a deep navy-to-black palette with vibrant blue and emerald accents. Optimized for high-conversion SaaS, logistics, fintech, and security-focused platforms. The style includes sophisticated typography pairing (Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi), carbon fiber textures, and scroll-triggered reveal animations. Key features include 3D-tilting cards, shimmer effects, and ultra-modern form layouts with blurred glass backgrounds.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional dark-mode UI with a secure, high-tech aesthetic. It relies on glassmorphic layers (12px blur), 3D interaction effects, and industrial typography to build trust and modern appeal. The layout is spacious with large headings and interactive components that respond to mouse movement.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a deep background color of #050811 and a subtle carbon fiber texture. Use a font system consisting of 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Weights: 800, 700) for headers and 'Satoshi' (Weights: 400, 500, 700) for body text. Implement glassmorphism using background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and a 1px border of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Define a 'gradient-animate' class with a 15s linear-gradient cycle (-45deg, #050811, #1e3a8a, #0f172a, #172554). Primary buttons should be #2563EB with a shadow-lg and shadow-blue-600/30. Input fields should use white/5% background with white/10% borders, transitioning to blue-500 on focus. All interactive cards must feature a 3D perspective container (1000px) and a shimmer animation effect using a moving linear-gradient overlay.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Floating Navigation Header
Design a fixed header with top-0 and z-100. Inside, place a max-w-7xl glassmorphic container (rounded-2xl, px-6, py-3) with a 1px border of white/10%. The logo should be on the left (blue-600 rounded square icon + extrabold text). The center contains a horizontal nav menu with gray-400 text (hover: white). The right side includes a primary CTA button (uppercase, tracking-wider, white background, black text).

### Split Sign-Up/Hero Section
Create a section with a grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 layout. The left column features a 'Secure Registration' tag (blue-500/10 background, blue-400 text), a 5xl to 6xl heading with a blue-to-emerald gradient span, and a list of benefits with emerald-500/20 rounded icons. The right column contains a large 3D perspective glass card (rounded-2.5rem, p-8).

### 3D Interactive Form Card
Construct a card with a 'perspective-container'. The card itself should have a white/5% border and 12px blur. Include a toggle switch at the top (full width, white/5% background, active state blue-600). Form fields should be stacked or in a 2-column grid, featuring custom icons (user, phone, mail, lock) at left-4 of the input. Add a dedicated OTP verification row with a 'Send Code' button embedded in the field layout. The primary action button at the bottom must be blue-600, full-width, and 16px padding.

### Glassmorphic Footer
Implement a footer with a black/50 background and backdrop-blur-md. The top border should be a subtle white/5% line. Arrange content in a 3-column flex layout (Branding, Links, Socials). Social icons should be in 40px circular glass buttons that fill blue-600 on hover. Include a centered copyright line at the bottom with text-xs gray-600.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Perspective Card — Cards that tilt dynamically based on mouse position.
Implement a card inside a container with 'perspective: 1000px'. The card should have 'transform-style: preserve-3d' and a transition of 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1). On mousemove, calculate the cursor offset from the center of the card and apply 'rotateX' and 'rotateY' values between -10deg and 10deg. Add a 'translateY(-10px)' on hover to create a lifting effect.

### Shimmer Loading Layer — Subtle animated light sweep across cards.
Apply an '::after' pseudo-element to cards. Set it to a linear-gradient of 45deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), transparent. Animate the 'left' property from -50% to 150% over a 6s infinite loop to create a slow-moving light sweep across the glass surface.

### Glass Input Fields — Modern inputs with internal icons and specific focus states.
Inputs should have a height of approx 56px, background white/5%, and a border-radius of 1rem (16px). Icons are placed absolutely 16px from the left. Text padding-left should be 44px. Focus state must change border to #3B82F6 and increase background opacity to 10%. Placeholders must be #4b5563.

style.description: The design uses a deep background (#050811) with a subtle carbon fiber texture overlay at 20% opacity. Typography pairs 'Cabinet Grotesk' for heavy, impactful headings and 'Satoshi' for clean body text. The primary accent is a vibrant blue (#2563EB) used for CTAs and status indicators, while emerald (#22C55E) provides positive feedback. Animation is central, featuring a 15-second animated gradient background, 3D card tilts, and smooth reveal-on-scroll effects (cubic-bezier 0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1).
